title: Three central lone pairs
hints: Put all three lone pairs in equatorial positions.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Xe has two bonded domains and three lone pairs. The three lone pairs occupy equatorial sites of the trigonal bipyramid, leaving the bonded atoms axial and linear.
statement:
What is the molecular geometry of $\ce{XeF2}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: The two F atoms are in opposite axial positions.
The arrangement is AX₂E₃, not a bent four-domain pattern.
A T shape uses three bonded neighbors.
